canon.note: Basic (121001) 140% at L10, total 100% at L6. Skill Iniquity Obliteration (121002) deals #1 = 140% (L10) to the primary and #2 = 70% to adjacent enemies, gains 3 Karma Reincarnation stacks. When Karma reaches max (8, L10 #1), the talent triggers Karmic Perpetuation follow-up: #2 = 90% (L10) bounce hits. Ultimate Divine Castigation (121003) deals #1 = 250% (L10) to one enemy, ignores Weakness type to reduce Toughness, and gains up to +60% DMG based on Toughness; #2 = 15% Quantum Break DMG. Energy limit 120. BA0 (Ranks): DMG bonus equal to 100% of Break Effect, cap 240%.

fixtures.env: Xueyi E0 solo vs 3 Quantum-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Iniquity Obliteration (121002) is Xueyi's damaging Skill action.
Iniquity Obliteration hits the designated enemy once per cast (4 Skill casts in the fixture).
Iniquity Obliteration is a Blast attack: 2 adjacent hits per cast × 4 casts.
Karma at max (8 stacks) triggers the Karmic Perpetuation follow-up attack (121004) — observed as its own HIT label.
Karmic Perpetuation fires 3 bounce hits per trigger (9 hits over the fixture's 3 triggers).
Divine Castigation (121003) is Xueyi's Ultimate action.
Divine Castigation hits the designated enemy once per Ultimate (2 Ultimates in the fixture).
Xueyi's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; it never falls back to a generic attack action.
Iniquity Obliteration primary hit L10 = 140% of ATK (121002 #1).
Iniquity Obliteration adjacent hit L10 = 70% of ATK (121002 #2).
Karmic Perpetuation bounce hit L10 = 90% of ATK (121004 #2).
Divine Castigation L10 = 250% of ATK (121003 #1) plus the Toughness-based bonus (up to +60%); observed first part = 4.0 including the full bonus.
Basic ATK L6 total = 100% (ladder 50→140), delivered as a 40/60 split → first part 0.4.
Basic ATK's second split part carries 60% of the 100% total → 0.6.
Xueyi's Ultimate uses the 120-Energy ladder (sp_need 120); over this fixture her action set regenerates exactly 191 Energy (includes follow-up energy).
Bonus Ability (Ranks, BA0) grants a DMG bonus equal to 100% of Break Effect (cap 240%); the fixture's 37.3% BE yields dmgAll 0.373.
Bonus Ability (BA1) grants DMG +10% for 1 turn while the enemy's Toughness is ≥50% at the start of the Ultimate.
Divine Castigation ignores Weakness type to reduce Toughness and applies the Quantum Break (Entanglement) DoT.
Skill hits build Karma before the Karmic Perpetuation follow-up can trigger in the same action window.
The Ultimate action starts before Divine Castigation damage resolves.
